fields.name: natural_wood_type
fields.description: Classifies wood by botanical group: softwood (conifers), hardwood (deciduous/broadleaf or tropical), mixed if composition is blended, unknown if not specified.

fields.name: natural_wood_species
fields.description: Lists common commercially used wood species relevant for construction and wood products. Use 'other' for uncommon species and 'unspecified' when unknown.

fields.name: natural_wood_product_form
fields.description: describes the form of the product

fields.name: natural_wood_drying_method
fields.description: Drying/conditioning method used prior to use. Method only, not the moisture value.

fields.name: moisture_content_percent
fields.description: Equilibrium moisture content at delivery/reference; use when specified (e.g., 12).

fields.name: natural_wood_processing
fields.description: Classifies the main processing state of the wood. Choose the dominant final form; categories are mutually exclusive.
